manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pull out the drawer of the cabinet with smooth finish and set the white-sided phone into it.

Task description: Open the drawer of the smooth wood-colored cabinet in the center of the view and put the phone with white sides and a black screen at the front left of the table inside it.

Success criteria: The phone must be inside the open drawer, close to its target placement position in both horizontal directions. Its placement height must be slightly above its initial tabletop position but still near table height. The left gripper must be open and release it.

## Execution tips

- When gripping the horizontal handle, choose a straight section away from the supports at either end and wrap the fingers around its upper and lower sides. Set the opening slightly wider than the bar thickness to reduce the chance of catching the panel or supports.
- When pulling the drawer, apply force outward perpendicular to the cabinet front. If it catches, make a small correction to the pulling direction instead of twisting sideways and slipping the gripper.
- When grasping the phone, grip straight sections of its long edges away from rounded corners, opening slightly wider than its width. Confirm the pads reach opposing side faces rather than merely pressing the screen edge or resting on the table.
- Leave enough drawer opening for the phone and gripper together. Complete rotation outside the opening where possible and keep the phone nearly flat to reduce corner contact with the sidewalls or top edge.
- Lower slightly during placement and release only after confirming that the drawer bottom supports the phone, avoiding release while suspended or leaving it balanced on the drawer edge.
